guides_howto_title: How to make a Tiny Desk AI meme video
guides_howto_intro: The Tiny Desk AI meme recasts the final moments of Charlie Wilson's NPR Tiny Desk encore with new faces, from a losing coach to your best friend. This guide covers the four steps, which photos give the best likeness, and what to do when a render misses.
guides_howto_step1_text: Use one photo per person: selfie, headshot or press photo with a single face, looking at the lens, well lit and unobstructed. Head and shoulders works best.
guides_howto_step2_text: The stage starts with the original five performers. Tap lead vocals, sax, keys or either backup singer and upload a photo. Recast any number of seats; skipped seats stay dogs, and clearing a dog keeps the original performer.
guides_howto_step3_text: Confirm the parody checkbox and hit render. It takes a few minutes, and you can leave the page.
guides_howto_step4_text: Download the 9:16 MP4 with the track. If TikTok or Instagram mutes it, post the muted copy and attach "Outstanding" from the in-app sounds.

guides_howto_need_people: Public figures are fine. Nobody under 18

guides_howto_photo_one_face: One person per photo, facing the camera. Crop group photos to a single face
guides_howto_photo_light: In focus with even light. Daylight beats a dim room
guides_howto_photo_no_cover: Nothing over the face: no sunglasses, masks, hands or hair
guides_howto_photo_no_filter: Skip cartoons, beauty filters and AI avatars
guides_howto_photo_plain: Plain clothing helps; logos and bold prints can leak into the shot

guides_howto_fix_heading: If it doesn't come out right
guides_howto_fix_intro: Nearly every miss traces back to the photo. Check these first:
guides_howto_fix_unlike: Weak likeness: try a sharper, front-facing photo with the face fully visible
guides_howto_fix_logo: Logos or prints on the clothes: use a photo in plain clothing
guides_howto_fix_not_swapped: The original singer remains, or the new face appears late: email us and we'll return the credits
guides_howto_fix_broken: Anything else obviously broken: email us for the credits back
guides_howto_timing_text: The meme spikes around game weekends, with fresh losing-coach versions after Saturday college games and Sunday NFL. Office, family and friend versions work any day of the week.
guides_howto_faq1_q: What do I need to make a Tiny Desk AI meme?
guides_howto_faq1_a: A clear photo of each person (1 to 5) and a few minutes. No CapCut, template, prompt or editor.

guides_howto_faq2_a: Kling 4.0 by Kuaishou in edit mode at 720p, rendering the full clip in one pass.
guides_howto_faq3_a: Typically 7 to 10 minutes. You'll get an email when it's ready.
guides_howto_faq4_q: Does the lip sync match the song?
guides_howto_faq4_a: Close but not perfect. Mouths follow the original performance, so they move on the beat. If it's clearly off, email us and we'll return the credits.
guides_howto_faq5_q: Why doesn't the face look right?
guides_howto_faq5_a: Usually the photo: sunglasses, a hand or hair across the face, a profile angle, a group shot or a heavy filter. Use one sharp, front-facing face. If the video is clearly broken, email us for the credits back.
guides_howto_faq6_q: Can I make it myself with Seedance or another AI video model?
guides_howto_faq6_a: You can, if you're comfortable editing and paying for an AI video model per shot. Expect paid renders for each shot and roughly an hour of cutting. Here it takes minutes and costs the same for 1 to 5 people.

guides_meme_meta_title: Tiny Desk Meme Explained: Charlie Wilson, "Outstanding" and AI
guides_meme_meta_description: The story behind the Tiny Desk meme: Charlie Wilson's 2023 NPR Tiny Desk, the Gap Band's 1982 hit, and the AI coach edits that spread across TikTok.
guides_meme_intro: The Tiny Desk meme is a roughly 19-second piece of Charlie Wilson's 2023 NPR Tiny Desk concert, edited with AI so someone new sings "Outstanding" with the band. It kicked off with losing football coaches on TikTok in October 2026 and quickly spread to teams, offices and friend groups.
guides_meme_timeline_1982: The Gap Band release "Outstanding" on Gap Band IV. Charlie Wilson is their lead singer.
guides_meme_timeline_2023: NPR Music publishes Charlie Wilson's Tiny Desk set. He ends with "Outstanding", laughing through the final chorus alongside the band.
guides_meme_timeline_2026: TikTok creators use AI to put that weekend's losing college football coaches into the final seconds of the encore. One edit tops 288,000 likes, and NFL, NBA and fan versions follow.
guides_meme_timeline_late: US interest in "tiny desk ai" rises from October 21 as fans make versions for every team, coach and group chat.
guides_meme_source_text: Charlie Wilson fronted The Gap Band, and "Outstanding" is among their signature songs. At his 2023 Tiny Desk he saved it for last: the band settles into the groove, he bursts into a laugh in close-up, the sax takes over, and the whole room sings it home. That final stretch is the meme clip.
guides_meme_why_laugh: The laugh is pure joy, which is hilarious on someone who just lost by 30

guides_meme_faq2_a: No. The coaches, athletes and celebrities in the viral clips are AI edits. The real performance is Charlie Wilson and his band.
guides_meme_faq3_q: Where does the Tiny Desk clip come from?
guides_meme_faq3_a: The ending of Charlie Wilson's NPR Tiny Desk concert (NPR Music, June 2023), in the vertical cut that went around TikTok: band, laugh close-up, sax break, band again.
